table_storage.scope: Read counts separate pre-admission resident loading from online streaming. The writer buffers at most one five-MiB Rust part. Online frame copies are bounded. Resident bytes are explicit; total runtime memory is not measured.

transport.clock: Worker Date.now; IO can advance this clock. These values are elapsed observations, not CPU billing measurements.

scope: Disposable role-separated registration from wallet-root shares, standard canonical key checks, streamed R2 keygen tables, consuming pool rollover, refill, empty-pool and replay probes. Client clocks measure all request intervals. Preparation precedes registration. No production admission or durable pool storage is claimed.
